fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami police scandals and calls for citizen oversight of the police; reports arrests connected to alleged gambling and grand jury leaks; political coverage of Florida primary contests and local county offices; discussion of Coral Gables Corporation refinancing and local business conditions; notices and commentary related to prohibition-era liquor and crime; coverage of local events including the Dade County Fair and a Miami beauty contest at Bayfront Park; along with letters to the editor, advertisements, and legal notices.
